name: awesome-design-md
description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
one_liner: A curated list of 'style guide' files copied from well-known brands' design systems — drop one into your project and an AI coding tool will build a UI that looks like that brand.
buyer: A freelance developer or small agency who needs to mock up a client's UI in a recognizable, professional style fast.
business_use_cases: A freelancer builds an MVP UI that already looks polished and on-brand for a pitch deck, instead of shipping something generic-looking.
An agency speeds up early client prototypes by starting from a style close to what the client has in mind.

money_ideas.idea: Sell an expanded, niche-specific pack (e.g. fintech or healthcare brand styles) as a one-time paid product.

steal_this: This is fundamentally a curated list, not a product — the honest weekend move is to use it as a free input to your own paid 'brand-matched AI UI' service for agency clients, not to sell the list itself.
